move: pricing cards rise, flip one by one with overshoot, flip back, drop
how: On a dark stage with perspective 1600px, a headline and subline fade up, then three preserve-3d card wrappers rise from y 80 with rotateX -20 and opacity 0 (expo.out 0.9s, 120ms stagger) showing their blank backs. From 17% each card flips rotationY 0 to 180 over 1.1s with back.out(1.4) at 550ms stagger while lifting 18px and settling (power2.out yoyo); the front-face contents (tier, price, list rows, button) fade up 10px at 40ms stagger. At 57% the middle card scales to 1.04 and back. At 77% the cards flip on to 360 in reverse order (power3.inOut 0.9s, 180ms stagger), then drop away (y 80, opacity 0, power3.in) and the header fades.
adapt: Replace the headline, three tiers with prices, feature rows and button labels, and the front colours; card count just needs the grid. Keep the 1.1s back.out(1.4) flip with 550ms stagger and the reverse-order flip-back.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the header and the flip cards (back and front faces) inside el with perspective on the row. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with labels at fractions of D; nth-child selectors scoped to el.
caveats: backface-visibility and preserve-3d required on the faces
from() tweens; use immediateRender:false if built after first paint
ends on an empty stage, restarts with the rise
